notablePrerequisites:
Cradle of the Sun.
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun's second ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun and Wirewood Lodge.
Activate Wirewood Lodge by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Repeat.

uses.name: Growing Rites of Itlimoc // Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun
